subject: Interviewer liaison: lend pool for sprint coverage & cadence
content:
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interviewer liaison: lend pool for sprint coverage & cadence

Hey team —

Acme ramped their on-site loop next week and RecruitOps just asked if we can provide a 6-person borrow pool for Monday–Wednesday (mostly late-morning PST). Attach is the current candidate slate and a quick skill-tag export. We need to cover: system design (2), backend pair (2), product judgment (1), PM loop (1).

Questions / asks:
- Can we identify volunteers to be on the standby lend pool for that 3-day sprint? Ideally folks who can do both system design and backend.
- If you can’t make it, please point to a direct swap (who you’d recommend).
- Markus/Monica: will you take the liaison role for logistics and CS handoff?

I’ll hold a 15-min sync tomorrow morning (9:30am PT) to confirm assignments and share the calendar invite (coverage-rotation.ics attached).

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sr. Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
